summary_en: This note discusses Bertrand's postulate and outlines two proof strategies: Erdos's argument via prime factors of the central binomial coefficient \(\binom{2n}{n}\), and a Chebyshev-style approach using estimates for the prime-counting function \(\pi(x)\). It also introduces several auxiliary lemmas and definitions used in these proofs.

problems.statement_en: For every positive integer \(n\), there exists a prime in the interval \((n,2n]\).
problems.statement_zh: 对于任意的正整数\(n\),区间\((n,2n]\)之间必然有一个素数。

problems.statement_en: For every integer \(n\geq 3\), the binomial coefficient \(\binom{2n}{n}\) cannot have any prime factor \(p\) satisfying \(\frac{2n}{3}<p\leq n\).
problems.statement_zh: 对于正整数\(n\geq 3\),组合数\(\binom{2n}{n}\)不可能包含\(\frac{2n}{3}<p\leq n\)的素因子。

problems.statement_en: If every prime factor \(p\) of \(\binom{2n}{n}\) satisfied \(p\leq \frac{2n}{3}\), then one would obtain the upper bound \(\binom{2n}{n}\leq 4^{2n/3}(2n)^{\sqrt{2n}}\), which contradicts the lower bound \(\binom{2n}{n}>\frac{4^n}{2n+1}\) for sufficiently large \(n\).
problems.statement_zh: 如果\(p\leq \frac{2n}{3}\)那么我们可以得到一个关于组合数的上界估计\(\binom{2n}{n}\leq 4^{2n/3}(2n)^{\sqrt{2n}}\)，而对于组合数还有下界\(\binom{2n}{n}>\frac{4^n}{2n+1}\)。二者结合会导致矛盾。

problems.statement_en: If \(p\) is prime and \(n\) is a positive integer, then \(\prod_{p\leq n} p < 4^n\).
problems.statement_zh: p是素数，n是正整数，那么\(\prod_{p\leq n} p < 4^n\)

problems.statement_en: For every integer \(n>1\) and prime \(p\), if \(r_p(n)\) denotes the exponent of \(p\) in \(\binom{2n}{n}\), then \(p^{r_p(n)}\leq 2n < p^{r_p(n)+1}\), equivalently \(r_p(n)=\lfloor \log_p(2n)\rfloor\).
problems.statement_zh: 对于正整数\(n>1\)以及素数p，\(p^{r_p(n)}\leq 2n<p^{r_p(n)+1}\)或者也可以理解为\(r_p(n)=\lfloor\log_{p}(2n)\rfloor\)此处\(r_p(n)\)表示组合数\(\binom{2n}{n}\)当中素因子p的指数。

problems.statement_en: Chebyshev proved that there exist constants \(C_1\approx 0.92\) and \(C_2\approx 1.1\) such that \(C_1\frac{x}{\log x}<\pi(x)<C_2\frac{x}{\log x}\).
Chebyshev's first function is defined by \(\theta(x)=\sum_{p\leq x}\log p\).

Chebyshev's second function is defined by \(\psi(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}\Lambda(n)\), where the von Mangoldt function \(\Lambda(n)\) is given by \(\Lambda(n)=\log p\) if \(n=p^k\) with \(k\geq 1\), and \(0\) otherwise.
problems.statement_zh: Chebyshev第二函数: \(\psi(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}\Lambda(n)\)其中\(\Lambda(n)\)表示Von Mangoldt函数，定义为: \(\Lambda(n):=\begin{cases}\log(p)&n=p^k,k\geq 1\\0&\text{Otherwise}\end{cases}\)
